title: Among charter schools in Santa Clara County with an SAT excellence rate abo
question: Among charter schools in Santa Clara County with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, identify the top 3 cities (by total K-12 enrollment) and return their average eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_050
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
      AND s.XCL_045 = 'Santa Clara'
      AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
city_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        e.XCL_050 AS city,
        SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_k12_enrollment,
        AVG(f.XCL_025 * 1.0 / f.XCL_024) AS avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
    FROM eligible_schools e
    JOIN frpm f ON e.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    GROUP BY e.XCL_050
)
SELECT 
    city,
    avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM city_metrics
ORDER BY total_k12_enrollment DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041, s.XCL_050
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
      AND s.XCL_045 = 'Santa Clara'
      AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
city_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        e.XCL_050 AS city,
        SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_k12_enrollment,
        AVG(f.XCL_025 * 1.0 / f.XCL_024) AS avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
    FROM eligible_schools e
    JOIN frpm f ON e.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    GROUP BY e.XCL_050
)
SELECT 
    city,
    avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM city_metrics
ORDER BY total_k12_enrollment DESC
LIMIT 3

      AND CAST(t.XCL_040 AS REAL) / t.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
city_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        e.XCL_050 AS city,
        SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_k12_enrollment,
        AVG(f.XCL_025 * 1.0 / f.XCL_024) AS avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
    FROM eligible_schools e
    JOIN frpm f ON e.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    GROUP BY e.XCL_050
)
SELECT 
    city,
    avg_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM city_metrics
ORDER BY total_k12_enrollment DESC
LIMIT 3
